_doc: 版本標識檔。guardian＝Workflow Guardian（hooks + MCP server）版本，Dashboard 標題與 MCP serverInfo 顯示；atom_memory＝原子記憶系統版本；release_date＝此版本正式發布日；release_theme＝此版本主題一句話。程式讀者：tools/workflow-guardian-mcp/lib/paths.js（只取 guardian / atom_memory）與 tools/install.py --verify（確認本檔可讀）；文件讀者 TECH.md。
release_theme: The closing reconcile gate and the rest of the verification-receipt machinery are removed: Stop keeps the red-test, background-wait, evasion and equivalence gates (the equivalence gate reminds rather than blocks), receipts live only in hook state and keep each sentinel's count, and the verification-batch gate treats a run as full only on the user's order keywords or the test-file count; the end-of-turn report drops the (j) evidence path; the handoff config section is renamed from auto_handoff to handoff (the old name is still read) and its early-warning label becomes [Handoff]; the install docs list the same default extensions as install.py, the realm scan also checks the zh-TW README and TECH pages, and the health check resolves references through Aka names
